title: A new non-panel kbmon module maps to code.md, so its item plans code.md in touches
goal: kb/_self/map.csv maps _tools/mon_*.py to kb/_self/code.md, whose Layout bullet names every kbmon module that is no panel, so check warns at plan time when a kbmon item's touches leave code.md out; in SP-3hgirkur two workers (ST-nighxizj, ST-atei6ybh) stopped on a stale code.md outside their touches and were resumed after the orchestrator widened them

run: import csv,sys;r=list(csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/map.csv',encoding='utf-8')));sys.exit(0 if any(x['doc']=='kb/_self/code.md' and x['pattern']=='_tools/mon_*.py' for x in r) else 1)
